newsitem.title: USA: Typhoon Beth over northern Luzon - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Beth over northern Luzon - WSC.

text.p: Typhoon Beth is over northern Luzon, in the Philippines, at this time, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Friday.
Top winds are near 85 mph and will weaken a little more as the storm travels across land. Wind damage is likely, however, and 6-12 inches of rain over Luzon will result in some major flooding.
Beth is expected to move out to sea into the South China Sea and intensify during the next 24 hours, becoming an increasing threat to shipping again, WSC said.
